english.title: Fail to surrender driving licence/certificate after notice of revocation
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been served with a notice under paragraph 8A(1) of Schedule 1 to the Road Traffic (New Drivers) Act 1995 requiring you to surrender your

(A)_[driving licence]_
(B)_[test certificate]_
(C)_[driving licence and test certificate]_

to the Secretary of State before the end of the period of 28 days beginning with the date on which the notice was served, failed without reasonable excuse to comply with that requirement
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 8A(2) of Schedule 1 to the Road Traffic (New Drivers) Act 1995.
